hallucinations: The executed query returned CAPEC-10 with no linked records for peers
rationale: The answer identifies CAPEC-10's peers CAPEC-46 and CAPEC-13 and states the required ATT&CK techniques T1574.006 and T1574.007, with T1562.003 also supported for CAPEC-13.
